Required outcome: Current device identity, ownership, OS, and management state
Overlap or conflict risk: Duplicate records or inconsistent device identity
Pilot test: Enroll one representative device per platform and reconcile identifiers

Required outcome: Detect offline, degraded, or resource-constrained endpoints
Overlap or conflict risk: Duplicate alerts or different health thresholds
Pilot test: Create a controlled health condition and verify one owned response path

Required outcome: Approve, deploy, verify, and report operating-system updates
Overlap or conflict risk: Conflicting rings, deadlines, reboots, or deferrals
Pilot test: Apply a representative update through the proposed authority and verify result evidence

Required outcome: Identify and remediate vulnerable supported applications
Overlap or conflict risk: Two tools update the same application or report different versions
Pilot test: Test one supported application and one unsupported application

Required outcome: Apply and verify required endpoint settings
Overlap or conflict risk: Competing profiles, scripts, or configuration baselines
Pilot test: Change one reversible setting and verify precedence, evidence, and rollback

Required outcome: Evaluate device state against approved requirements
Overlap or conflict risk: RMM health interpreted as MDM compliance or vice versa
Pilot test: Make one device intentionally noncompliant and verify detection and recovery

Required outcome: Assign, install, update, and remove managed applications
Overlap or conflict risk: Duplicate installers, version drift, or removal conflicts
Pilot test: Deploy and remove one representative application through the proposed authority

Required outcome: Run authorized repeatable endpoint actions with result evidence
Overlap or conflict risk: Policy remediation and RMM scripts repeatedly undo each other
Pilot test: Run one reversible action and verify approval, output, failure, and rollback

Required outcome: Provide authorized attended or unattended technician access
Overlap or conflict risk: Multiple unattended agents or unclear session authority
Pilot test: Complete one approved session and verify identity, consent, recording, and closure evidence

Required outcome: Report and remediate required storage encryption state
Overlap or conflict risk: Conflicting escrow, remediation, or compliance sources
Pilot test: Verify a compliant device, a noncompliant device, and recovery-key handling

Required outcome: Use device state in identity and access decisions
Overlap or conflict risk: Stale or conflicting posture blocks legitimate access or permits unsafe access
Pilot test: Test one allowed and one denied access condition with approved accounts

Required outcome: Provision and retire trusted connectivity profiles
Overlap or conflict risk: Duplicate profiles, certificate renewal gaps, or stranded secrets
Pilot test: Issue, renew, and remove one non-production profile

Required outcome: Lock, retire, locate when permitted, or wipe an enrolled mobile device
Overlap or conflict risk: Wrong-device action or unclear privacy and approval authority
Pilot test: Use a non-production device to test approval, action, evidence, and recovery limits

Required outcome: Separate business controls and data from personal use
Overlap or conflict risk: Collection, wipe, support, or monitoring exceeds approved scope
Pilot test: Review visible data and test selective removal on a representative BYOD device

Required outcome: Turn device or compliance signals into acknowledged work
Overlap or conflict risk: Duplicate tickets, unowned alerts, or mismatched severity
Pilot test: Trigger one RMM health alert and one MDM compliance alert and trace each to closure

Required outcome: Preserve attributable records for actions, policy, sessions, and outcomes
Overlap or conflict risk: Evidence split across tools with no durable system of record
Pilot test: Export one complete action history and confirm actor, target, time, action, and result

Required outcome: Remove access, agents, policy, applications, and retained records as approved
Platform or scope: Transfer; termination; lost device; vendor exit
Overlap or conflict risk: One tool retires the device while another retains authority or access
Pilot test: Retire one test device and reconcile every residual control and record

Required outcome: Assign accepted gaps to an owner with an expiry and retest
Platform or scope: All unresolved overlap and coverage gaps
Overlap or conflict risk: Permanent undocumented exceptions or controls with no accountable owner
Pilot test: Create one time-limited exception and verify expiry notification and review
